banking77.split_rule: official test frozen; official train 80/10/10 stratified by intent

boolq.split_rule: official validation/dev frozen as test; remaining groups 80/10/10; group_id is Wikipedia title when present, else a hash of the passage (google/boolq omits title; original jsonl includes it)

clinc150.split_rule: official train+test; official validation split even/odd into val/calib

sst5.split_rule: official test/validation preferred; 10% of train carved as calibration

wikispeedia.split_rule: split by target article; replay '<' via navigation stack; cap 255 keeping gold
